primary_metric: Squared error against observed daily 24-hour share vectors, averaged equally over eligible days.
secondary_metrics: Log score (floor 1e-12), peak-hour error, fixed 07-10 and 16-19 share errors.
limitations: Observed daily profiles are noisy and heterogeneous.
Paired daily observations may be dependent; no iid significance claims.
This does not identify an unrestricted continuous density inside hourly bins.
The cyclic penalty comparator is an ordinary periodic second-difference log-probability smoother, not a reproduction of Eilers harmonic PCL.
